projects.title: LA-ENERGAIA
projects.description: In collaboration with the project’s technical manager and lead programmer, I successfully managed the support of LA-ENERGAIA’s development and project management teams, and successfully planned and provided for all aspects of the project’s network and systems operations.  As one of a three-member technical team responsible for the project’s technical specifications and direction, I successfully promoted the use of open-source software and adherence to industry standards. LA-ENERGAIA is built in Drupal, PHP, Apache 2, and Postgresql 8.4. It employs a number of custom Drupal extensions as well as a custom theme.
